title: Hedra Labs Cuts Krea 3 Runtime to 3.3 Seconds on AMD MI355X
summary:
Hedra Labs utilized an autonomous research system to optimize the way Krea AI's image generation model interacts with semiconductor hardware. The resulting update reduced the processing time for the Krea 3 diffusion transformer on AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs from 22.9 seconds to 3.3 seconds, which is a 6.9x increase in speed while maintaining 98.3% of the original BF16 quality as measured by the Structural Similarity Index Measure.

The technical improvements included cutting GPU transfer wait times from 18% to 2% and increasing MXFP6 GEMM performance by 2.8x compared to BF16. Krea AI is now encouraging users who operate image editing tools in production environments to implement the speed gains on AMD hardware.
